# FITS Contact App

> A single-screen Android app for [fits.dk](https://fits.dk) (Framework for IT Security, an
> AI-powered policy-automation product): three FITS contact cards on a circular horizontal
> swipe pager, each showing a QR code — a vCard 3.0 generated on-device with ZXing — that any
> phone camera saves straight into its contacts. No network access, no permissions.

FITS Contact App is open-source (Apache-2.0), created by Babak Bandpey / Cocode.
It's Kotlin + Jetpack Compose, minSdk 26, compileSdk 37, a single Gradle module built and
run entirely from the CLI.

## Docs

- [Contributing](https://github.com/cocodedk/fits-qr/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, git
